python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path("src/codegen_support/runtime/io/scandir.rs")
s = p.read_text()
old = '''    emitter.instruction("bl __rt_path_cstr");                                   // convert path to C string, x0=cstr
    emitter.instruction("str x0, [sp, #24]");                                   // hold the C path across the result-array allocation'''
new = '''    emitter.instruction("bl __rt_path_cstr");                                   // convert path to C string, x0=cstr
    emitter.instruction("str x0, [sp, #24]");                                   // hold the C path across the result-array allocation
    // php names what the PROGRAM wrote: `scandir(file:///no/such)`, not the path that URL was
    // reduced to. The strip published it; the opener below still gets the path itself.
    emitter.instruction("bl __rt_path_diag_name");
    emitter.instruction("str x0, [sp, #48]");                                   // the name the two warnings print'''
assert s.count(old) == 1, s.count(old)
s = s.replace(old, new)
old = '''    emitter.instruction("ldr x1, [sp, #24]");                                   // the NUL-terminated C path
    emitter.instruction("mov x9, #0");                                          // measured length'''
new = '''    emitter.instruction("ldr x1, [sp, #48]");                                   // the name php prints, URL and all
    emitter.instruction("mov x9, #0");                                          // measured length'''
assert s.count(old) == 1, s.count(old)
p.write_text(s.replace(old, new))
print("scandir wired")
